headline: Tara Chand wins Rs 45.73 Cr crane deployment order from BHEL and Adani
summary: Tara Chand Infralogistics Solutions secures a Rs 45.73 crore work order for crane deployment across BHEL and Adani Power plants. The order spans Q3 FY27 to Q4 FY29, adding to the company's backlog.

headline: Vans Electro wins Rs 4.45 Cr order from Agrawal Power
summary: Vans Electroengineerings received a Rs 4.45 crore work order for vacuum circuit breakers. The company reported zero revenue in the last TTM, highlighting execution risk.

headline: GGBL wins Rs 347.39 Cr order from NLC India
summary: Ganesh Green Bharat secures Rs 347.39 Cr work order for solar modules. Book-to-bill ratio stands at 0.3x based on TTM revenue of Rs 1,067.60 Cr.

headline: Transrail wins Rs 927 cr EPC & supply order from Domestic/USA clients
summary: Transrail Lighting secures Rs 927 crore order for 765kV/400kV lines and USA conductors. Order book covers 1.65 quarters of revenue. Q1FY27 inflow was Rs 2068 cr.

headline: Ceigall India wins Rs 684 crore NHAI order for Haryana highway
summary: Confirmed work order from NHAI. Book-to-bill stands at 4.26x annual revenue. Q2FY27 revenue grew to Rs 1028 Cr with OPM at 17.02%.

headline: Artemis Adr Marketplace wins Rs 24.6 crore order from Jupitice
summary: Artemis Adr Marketplace secured a Rs 24.6 crore software development contract from Jupitice Justice Technologies. This significant order contrasts with zero reported TTM revenue and negative ROCE, highlighting a potential pivot in business model.

headline: Highness Microelectronics receives Rs 21 lakh order for medical workstations
summary: Highness Microelectronics disclosed a Rs 21 lakh order for medical-grade touch-enabled workstations. The deal supports modular operating rooms at a metro hospital chain. Order book coverage remains limited relative to recent inflows.

headline: Agarwal Toughened Glass wins Rs 4.24 crore order
summary: Agarwal Toughened Glass secures Rs 4.24 crore supply order for a Jaipur medical college. The deal adds to recent inflows, boosting backlog visibility for FY27 execution.

headline: Obsc Perfection wins Rs 17 Cr order from Domestic Components Mfr
summary: Obsc Perfection secures Rs 17 crore work order for EGR Gas Pipe flanges. Book-to-bill context and execution trends analyzed.

headline: Sattrix Independent Director resigns
summary: Abhishek Madanlal Binaykia resigned as Independent Director of Sattrix Information Security Ltd effective November 16, 2026, citing other professional commitments.

headline: Chamunda Electricals wins Rs 1.69 Cr order from GETCO
summary: Chamunda Electricals secured a Rs 1.69 crore work order from GETCO for control room shifting. This represents a significant inflow relative to its micro-cap status, with annual revenue growth of 27.5% in FY26.

headline: Panchmahal Steels wins Rs 25.25 Cr order from BHEL
summary: Panchmahal Steels secured a Rs 25.25 crore work order from BHEL for SS wire supply. This adds to recent inflows, though financials show negligible revenue and negative ROCE.

headline: Whiteforce wins Rs 1.51 Cr work order from Hindustan Copper
summary: Whiteforce receives a confirmed work order worth Rs 1.514 crore from Hindustan Copper Limited for a one-year period. This adds to the company's order book, which saw significant inflows in Q1FY27.

headline: Newgen wins Rs 20.51 cr order from Just Retirement
summary: Newgen Software Technologies secured a Rs 20.51 crore work order from Just Retirement Management Services for document management platforms. The order adds to the disclosed book, which covers 0.50 quarters of average revenue.

headline: Rdb Infrastructure wins Rs 20 crore order from Oswal Residential
summary: Rdb Infrastructure & Power secures Rs 20 crore turnkey order for Experience Centre infrastructure. Total disclosed order book stands at Rs 348.64 crore, covering 12.82 quarters of average revenue.

headline: KSB wins Rs 8.5 crore order from ONGC for pump replacement
summary: KSB received a Rs 8.5 crore work order from ONGC for replacing 7 injection pumps. This adds to the Rs 1,180 crore backlog, bringing book-to-bill coverage to 1.62 quarters.

headline: Dhabriya Polywood wins Rs 11.79 Cr order from Conscient Group
summary: Dhabriya Polywood secures Rs 11.79 crore work order for uPVC doors/windows. Book-to-bill ratio stands at 0.15x. Quarterly revenue shows steady growth with OPM above 20%.

headline: Itcons wins Rs 0.67 Cr order from Indian Army
summary: Itcons E-Solutions secured a Rs 67.42 lakh work order from the Indian Army for resource deployment. This small-ticket addition contrasts with larger recent inflows, highlighting a mix of contract sizes.

headline: Simca Advertising gets Rs 5 lakh ad deal from MADC
summary: Simca Advertising receives a Rs 5 lakh Leave and License Agreement from MADC for Shirdi Airport advertising. The order represents a small fraction of revenue but signals continued client acquisition.

headline: EIEL wins Rs 228 Cr order from Arie Energy
summary: Enviro Infra Engineers secures Rs 228 crore EPC order for 100 MW wind project. Order book coverage stands at 3.85 quarters. Q2FY27 inflow accelerated to Rs 738 crore.

summary: Waaree Renewable Technologies secured a Rs 22 crore scope enhancement for a 150 MWac solar project. Order book coverage stands at 0.29 quarters, with Q2FY27 inflows surging to Rs 224.79 crore.

headline: Gujarat Inject Kerala wins Rs 6.25 cr order from Deon Energy
summary: Confirmed supply order for 8,065 solar modules. Q1FY27 inflow was Rs 30.05 crore, showing strong client retention with Deon Energy.

headline: Agastya Energy wins Rs 106 Cr EPC order from IMC Solar
summary: Agastya Energy And Infrastructure secures Rs 106.04 Cr EPC & O&M contract from IMC Solar BDN LLP. This large order contrasts with recent Rs 7.39 Cr inflow, though execution faces negative OPM trends.

headline: Dee Dev wins Rs 46 Cr order from US EPC firm

headline: Gr Infraprojects wins Rs 91.6 crore MMLP Varanasi order
summary: Gr Infraprojects secured a Rs 91.6 crore DBFOT order for MMLP Varanasi. Book-to-bill stands at 4.16x. Quarterly revenue shows improving OPM trends despite negative operating cashflows.

headline: BDL wins Rs 1307 crore order from Indian Navy
summary: Bharat Dynamics secured a Rs 1307 crore mega order for heavyweight torpedoes. This adds to a strong Q2FY27 inflow, boosting the backlog significantly.

headline: Hec Infra wins Rs 6.75 Cr order from CESC Ltd
summary: Hec Infra Projects secured a Rs 6.75 crore work order from CESC Limited for power transformer supply. The company's total disclosed order book stands at Rs 217.69 crore, offering 6.05 quarters of revenue coverage.

headline: Prospect Consumer Products signs Rs 34.2 Lakh supply deal
summary: PCL enters distribution agreement with DJT Retailers for DriFrutz brand. Order value is Rs 34.21 lakh, representing a new revenue stream for the SME FMCG firm.

headline: Om Power wins Rs 101.56 Cr order from UGVCL
summary: Om Power Transmission secures Rs 101.56 Cr turnkey contract from Uttar Gujarat Vij Company Limited for underground cable network conversion at Ambaji.

summary: Navkar Corporation secured a Rs 48 crore contract from Southern Railway for a Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal. The deal includes an 18-month construction phase and a 35-year license period, adding to its transport infrastructure portfolio.

headline: Ahluwalia wins Rs 310 Cr order from Bennett University
summary: Ahluwalia Contracts secured a Rs 310 crore work order for construction at Bennett University. The order adds to the backlog, with current book-to-bill coverage at 0.00 quarters based on disclosed data.

headline: Dmr Engineering wins Rs 21.60 Cr order from Studio Ing. G. Pietrangeli
summary: Dmr Engineering secured a Rs 21.60 Cr engineering consultancy order for ADB/DPN Nagaland. Book-to-bill stands at 18.1x, with strong liquidity but recent margin compression.

headline: Sikko Industries wins Rs 229.98 Cr order from OWC Uganda
summary: Sikko Industries secured a Rs 229.98 crore supply contract for organic fertilizer granules from Operation Wealth Creation, Uganda. The order value is 3.27x the company's annual revenue.

headline: Aaron Industries wins Rs 2 crore home lift order from Gulf Elevators
summary: Aaron Industries secured a Rs 2 crore contract for EVOQ360 Home Lifts. With zero disclosed backlog in prior quarters, this order represents a significant book-to-bill event for the microcap.

headline: Pranik Logistics wins Rs 3.08 Cr order from BPCL
summary: Pranik Logistics secures a Rs 3.08 crore work order from BPCL for warehousing management. The order represents significant backlog addition for the SME transport services firm.

summary: Current Infraprojects secured a Rs 4.03 crore work order from BSF for off-grid solar plants. This adds to recent inflows, with FY26 revenue growing 76.8% YoY, though operating cashflow remains negative.

headline: Aarti Industries bags Rs 1500 Cr long-term supply deal
summary: Aarti Industries secures a Rs 1500 crore, 10+ year manufacturing and supply agreement with a global speciality chemical company. This mega order represents ~57% of quarterly revenue, boosting the order book significantly.

headline: Signpost India wins Rs 36 Cr ad rights from Chalo Mobility
summary: Signpost India secures exclusive 5-year advertising rights for Chalo Premium Buses in Mumbai. The Rs 36 crore order represents ~24% of average quarterly revenue, with no prior backlog disclosed in recent quarters.

headline: Global Pet Industries wins Rs 15.04 Cr order for pet stretch molding machine
summary: Global Pet Industries secured a Rs 15.04 crore work order for supply of pet stretch molding machines. The order represents a significant inflow relative to its SME scale, with a 3-month execution timeline.

headline: Univastu wins Rs 15.39 Cr order from Colossus Infra
summary: Univastu secured a Rs 15.39 crore work order from M/s Colossus Infra Project Pvt Ltd. The company's total disclosed order book stands at Rs 649.56 crore, providing 6.14 quarters of revenue coverage.

headline: Abhishek Integrations bags Rs 3.15 Cr AAI order
summary: Abhishek Integrations secures a significant Rs 3.15 crore order from Airports Authority of India for E&M maintenance at Kolkata airport. This 24-month contract adds to its recent order book.

headline: Lumino Industries wins Rs 496 Cr order from power T&D clients
summary: Lumino Industries secured Rs 496 Cr in manufacturing and EPC orders. This represents 85% of avg quarterly revenue. Book-to-bill remains low due to limited prior disclosures.

headline: Tamboli Industries wins Rs 20 Cr order from Global OEM
summary: Tamboli Industries secures Rs 20 crore contract for precision components. Order represents ~90% of avg quarterly revenue. Backlog coverage remains low at 0.00 quarters.

headline: Hazoor Multi Projects wins Rs 28.10 Cr NHAI order
summary: Hazoor Multi Projects secures a Rs 28.10 crore work order from NHAI for fee collection in Karnataka. Total disclosed order book stands at Rs 524.55 crore, covering 3.68 quarters of revenue.

headline: Viviana Power Tech wins Rs 466.74 Cr order from MGVCL
summary: Viviana Power Tech secured a Rs 466.74 crore work order from MGVCL for HT line conversion. This large-scale contract boosts the order book, though high leverage and negative operating cashflow remain key monitoring points.

headline: Kp Green Engineering wins Rs 272.32 Cr order for solar & infra
summary: Kp Green Engineering secures Rs 272.32 Cr confirmed order. Book-to-bill ratio stands at 1.4x based on recent disclosures. Q2FY27 inflow was Rs 497.63 Cr.

headline: Azad Engineering wins Rs 52.68 Cr order from BHEL
summary: Azad Engineering secured a Rs 52.68 crore work order from BHEL for gas turbine components. The order represents ~29% of average quarterly revenue. Book-to-bill data unavailable in recent quarters.

headline: Ircon wins Rs 862.45 cr EPC order from East Central Railway
summary: Ircon International secured a Rs 862.45 crore Letter of Acceptance for EPC works from East Central Railway. The order covers track construction and material supply, adding to the company's backlog.

headline: Avantel wins Rs 12.04 crore order from L&T for Satcom maintenance
summary: Avantel secures Rs 12.04 crore annual maintenance contract from Larsen & Toubro. Order book coverage stands at 9.14 quarters. Q2FY27 revenue grew to Rs 74.70 crore.

headline: Bajel wins Rs 200 Cr EPC order for GIS substations in Mumbai
summary: Bajel Projects secures Rs 200 crore EPC order for 220kV GIS substations. Order book covers 4.41 quarters of revenue. Q2FY27 OPM at 0.06% signals margin stress.

headline: Nis Management wins Rs 6.24 Cr order from CRM Enterprise
summary: Nis Management secures Rs 6.24 Cr work order for surveillance systems in West Bengal. Order book coverage stands at 1.38 quarters. Recent quarterly inflows show acceleration.

headline: Premier Energies wins Rs 4001 Cr order for solar supply and EPC
summary: Premier Energies secured a Rs 4001 crore work order for 2,308 MW solar cell/module supplies and EPC execution. This follows a Rs 6022 crore inflow in Q2FY27, boosting the order book to 2.56x quarterly revenue.

headline: SEPC wins Rs 854.57 crore order from SAIL for Burnpur pellet plant
summary: SEPC secured a Rs 854.57 crore work order from SAIL for Pellet Plant BOP works. This adds to a robust order book, with total disclosed inflows of Rs 4299.31 crore over the last three quarters.
